# Workshop 04. The Developers Toolbox and AI

# Introduce GitHub Copilot and the chattr package

```{r}
# Load tidyverse and palmerpenguins libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(palmerpenguins)
```

```{r}
# Create a ggplot scatter plot using the penguins dataset.
# Plot bill_length_mm on the x-axis and bill_depth_mm on the y-axis.
# Colour points by species and use geom_point with size 3.
# Add a minimal theme and clean labels.
ggplot(data = penguins, aes(x = bill_length_mm, y = bill_depth_mm, color = species)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Bill Length vs Bill Depth in Penguins",
       x = "Bill Length (mm)",
       y = "Bill Depth (mm)",
       color = "Species")
```

```{r}
# Create a boxplot using the penguins dataset.
# Compare flipper_length_mm across different species faceted by island
# Using a custom colour palette.
boxplot <- ggplot(data = penguins, aes(x = species, y = flipper_length_mm, fill = species)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  facet_wrap(~ island) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("darkorange", "steelblue", "forestgreen")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Flipper Length by Species and Island",
       x = "Species",
       y = "Flipper Length (mm)",
       fill = "Species")
boxplot
```

```{r}
# Create a scatter plot mapping body_mass_g against flipper_length_mm
# Add a linear regression trend line (geom_smooth) for each species
scatter_plot <- ggplot(data = penguins, aes(x = flipper_length_mm, y = body_mass_g, color = species)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Body Mass vs Flipper Length in Penguins",
       x = "Flipper Length (mm)",
       y = "Body Mass (g)",
       color = "Species")
scatter_plot
```
